title: Old address: a valid shared value presented at another tenant slug is refused with the one 401
description: SECURITY (decision 0091 sections 6 and 8.1, INV-1, INV-5; REQ-859). The administrator of the tenant creates its shared value. The phone presents that valid value at the old address of a made-up slug (the dry run uses uat-no-such-slug; no request goes to a real other tenant, as in the retry group, T-2343): a catalog read and a movement post are both refused with the same 401 body the old address gives for a revoked value (status, title and detail identical, see SEC-OLD-01), and nothing is posted (the post never reaches the tenant: the slug decides the tenant before the value is checked). The run's old address names the other slug, so this file cannot read the tenant through the old address; the absence of a write is the 401 itself plus SEC-OLD-01 step s13. Two refused presented values spend two failure tokens of the runner's address. Cleanup revokes the value.
